items.title: 3 Stocks Linked To Rising Trading Volume After The Nvidia AI Shock

items.title: PFF Is the Preferred Stock ETF Everyone Knows. PFFA Adds Leverage and a Manager, and Pays Monthly

items.title: KKR set to acquire majority stake in Portugal’s Logoplaste, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- KKR & Co (NYSE:KKR) has reached an agreement to acquire Portuguese packaging manufacturer Logoplaste in a transaction that could value the company at more than €1.2 billion ($1.3 billion), including debt, according to Bloomberg News, citing people familiar with the matter. The pact, which could be signed within days, follows exclusive negotiations that began in September after rival bidder Apax Partners LLP withdrew from the process.

items.title: KKR Invests in India Renewables Business Run by Petronas-Backed Gentari
